snippet.title: Syncblade (Rhythm Game) - New Gameplay & Features Trailer
snippet.description:
Syncblade is our new rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

Wishlist Syncblade now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043810/Syncblade/

Join Syncblade Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/7Kgm6WQwWE

Listen to the OST on Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/album/3FMUYLlrtxxTiXR5kCHaUl
